stage.name: Vortex
stage.description: The ocean seeks to devour all, and the cultists rouse the vortex. Sea Terrors gladly rush forth, preying on the food caught within.
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

bone_sea_drifter.name: Bone Sea Drifter
bone_sea_drifter.flavourText: Sea Terrors travel in large swarms, seeking carcasses to feast on and becoming food for other Sea Terrors themselves.

retching_broodmother.name: Retching Broodmother
retching_broodmother.flavourText: Sea Terror mothers that throw fake offspring at oncoming threats, allowing the true offspring to flee.
abilities: Summons 1 <Baleful Broodling> near the target when dealing damage

caster_speedboat.name: Caster Speedboat
caster_speedboat.flavourText: A Tidal Caster on a speedboat. The Caster will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion
The <Caster> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed

tidal_caster.name: Tidal Caster
tidal_caster.flavourText: Professionally trained casters whose duties involve simulating the tides of Dossoles's sea. Adept at using Originium Arts that mimic the erosive effect of the tides.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion

chest_seaborn.name: Chest Seaborn
chest_seaborn.flavourText: Sea Terror disguised as a treasure chest, often used by Bishops of the Deep to protect hideouts.

crying_thief.name: Crying Thief
crying_thief.flavourText: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

fatty.name: Fatty
fatty.flavourText: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
abilities: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

emergency.condition: Condition: Enemies have greatly increased ATK, DEF, HP, and Movement Speed
